text:
Horas is alo did not in empery for a price of wood
pointed across two other perpendicular ones, to fulain
the boards, phunks, so, which make bridges over-final
rivers and no divers other conditions.

parsed.faithful: Horse is also used in carpentry, for a piece of wood jointed across two other perpendicular ones, to fustain the boards, planks, &c. which make bridges over small rivers; and on divers other occasions.
parsed.modern: Horse is also used in carpentry, for a piece of wood jointed across two other perpendicular ones, to sustain the boards, planks, &c. which make bridges over small rivers; and on divers other occasions.
